title: Chapter 141 The Queen Of The Divine Dynasty Is The City Lord'S Wife
content:
Chapter 141 The Queen Of The Divine Dynasty Is The City Lord'S Wife

Bang!

Two figures suddenly retreated in opposite directions at a terrifying speed.

"Ahem."

In the distance, Jiang Bei looked at Yan Lingyun in the air with fear.

It was Yan Lingyun who blocked their attacks just now.

Not only that, the opponent easily pushed them back tens of thousands of feet away.

At this moment, his entire arm had lost consciousness, which showed the horror of the opponent's strength.

He knew that Yan Lingyun was very strong, but he didn't know why she was so strong.

He had already reached the super god realm, and the gap between his strength and the opponent was so big.

"Madam, why are you here?"

Jiang Bei put away his shock, looked at Yan Lingyun in confusion and asked.

He thought Yan Lingyun left with the city lord.

Unexpectedly, Yan Lingyun would appear here.

At this time, he suddenly remembered the name that the sword cultivator woman had just called Yan Lingyun.

Your Majesty?

After a long time.

Jiang Bei sat in the palace with a complicated look.

The Empress of the Divine Dynasty was actually the wife of their Lord of the City.

No wonder there had never been a conflict between the Desolate City and the Divine Dynasty.

And he came to the Divine Dynasty because he wanted to seek strong people.

Looking at Yan Lingyun, who looked indifferent in front of him, Jiang Bei hesitated for a moment and said slowly: "Madam, can we spar with each other?"

Spar!

Fortunately, there were only Yan Lingyun and Jiang Bei here.

If the other strong people of the Divine Dynasty knew about it, I don't know how shocked they would be.

Who dares to spar with His Majesty?

The entire Divine Dynasty was fought by His Majesty himself.

And Yan Lingyun was also a little surprised. Looking at Jiang Bei, who didn't seem to be joking, Yan Lingyun revealed a trace of her own aura.

"Are you sure?"

Above the super-god realm, and far beyond!

Feeling this aura, Jiang Bei swallowed his saliva and nodded.

Seeing this, Yan Lingyun shook her head and smiled.

"Well, then come on."

Boom!

On this day, a terrifying aura surged out of the palace of the Divine Dynasty.

The entire Divine Dynasty was trembling wildly.

That was the breath of His Majesty!

They had not heard about their female emperor taking action for a long time.

In the palace.

Jiang Bei had already lost consciousness and lay on the ground.

At this time, the aura revealed by Yan Lingyun had reached the peak of the mortal realm.

It was not far from becoming an immortal.

The gap was too big.

And Yan Lingyun did not show mercy.

"Come on, carry him down."

Yan Lingyun clapped her hands and said slowly.

Then two guards appeared and carried the unconscious Jiang Bei down.

In fact, Yan Lingyun was also doing it for Jiang Bei's good.

This time, Jiang Bei was really too confident.

Confidence is indeed a good thing, but being too confident is conceited.

If he didn't know Jiang Bei, Jiang Bei would have died when he first appeared in the Divine Dynasty.

At this time, Jian Xin appeared beside Yan Lingyun.

"Your Majesty."

Looking at Jian Xin who looked respectful in front of him, Yan Lingyun nodded slightly.

"How do you feel?"

Jian Xin looked a little solemn.

"I underestimated the enemy."

If she had been absolutely serious from the beginning, she would not have lost.

Of course, this is what she thought.

Hearing Jian Xin's words, Yan Lingyun shook her head and said, "I want you to know that the most abundant thing in this world is genius monsters. You think you are very strong, but you don't know that there are stronger people than you."

Hearing this, Jian Xin was silent.

She had understood this truth a long time ago.

What is a genius monster? A long time ago, she thought it was used to describe her.

Until she met Yan Lingyun.

What genius monster, in front of Yan Lingyun, it was just a joke.

Is there really someone more evil than your majesty in the world?

Jian Xin didn't know.

Looking at Jian Xin's complicated expression, Yan Lingyun sighed and said nothing more.

If Jian Xin could think things through, Jian Xin's swordsmanship would be further advanced.

The one with the most stable heart of Taoism she has seen so far is Ao Qing.

Ao Qing looks unreliable, but his heart of Taoism is really more solid than ever before.

At this time, a shadow suddenly appeared beside Yan Lingyun.

"Your Majesty, there is an abnormal movement in the unknown border."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun's expression was moved.

"Where is Shen Yi?"

"Your Majesty, General Shen Yi has come out of retreat and is guarding there in person."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun breathed a sigh of relief.

Shen Yi, the first general of the Divine Dynasty.

He is known as the existence of the entire Divine Dynasty with the closest strength to the Divine Dynasty Empress, and is also Yan Lingyun's most trusted subordinate.

Shen Yi has never let her down.

After a moment of silence, Yan Lingyun turned and walked into the house, then sat at the table and started writing.

After a moment, Yan Lingyun stuffed the paper into the envelope and handed it to the shadow in front of him.

"When Jiangbei wakes up, give him this letter."

"This emperor is going to retreat, please leave."

"Yes, Your Majesty."

It can be seen that Yan Lingyun looked a little anxious.

On the other hand, the progress of the Wasteland City is also extremely fierce.

In all known star regions, the forces of the Divine Dynasty and the Wasteland City are almost the main ones.

Other star regions have either been conquered by the two major forces or have surrendered.

Countless existences began to speculate that the next one might be a great battle between the two top forces.

At that time, the whole world will inevitably be in turmoil.

In the palace of the Lord of the Wilderness City.

"Did God's reaction to us?"

Awei looked at An Xing and asked.

After the last incident, An Xing had sent a large number of spies to investigate the power of the Divine Dynasty.

After so long, I think there must be some progress.

In the huge chamber.

Almost all the high-level buildings in the deserted city have gathered here, which is a rare scene in a century.

Even Yun Qi has already rushed back from the front line.

Since the city lord has given them the Huangcheng with confidence, they naturally cannot let anything happen to the Huangcheng.

At this moment, everyone's eyes were looking at An Xing.

Nowadays, the most powerful people in the entire wasteland city are Awei and Anxing, followed by Gu Chen.

Although the few people are not the strongest, they are respected by everyone.

At this time, An Xing's expression was a little complicated.

"Do you still remember the city lord's wife?"

An Xing asked.

Hearing this, everyone looked confused.

Yan Lingyun is not a secret that the city lord has a wife, so everyone still knows it.

"Brother An, did you know something?"

Looking at everyone's puzzled gaze, An Xing slowly said, "After my investigation, the empress of the Divine Dynasty is the wife of the city lord."

As soon as these words came out, everyone was stunned.

So that's it, so that's it.

At this moment, everyone finally understood what the city lord had told.

Do your best to help the Divine Dynasty.

It turns out that they are a family.

"What should we do now? Are we going to meet the lady?"

Gu Chen opened his mouth.

Awei and others hesitated.

And at this moment, a familiar voice sounded from outside the house.

"Master, everyone, I'm back!"

The next moment, Lu Xue's figure appeared at the door.

Seeing Lu Xue, everyone quickly stood up and saluted respectfully.

"Have you met Miss!"

And Gu Chen also came to Lu Xue.

"Xiaoxue, why are you back?"
